content: TensorFlow.js v4.22.0 (production-ready, full ecosystem, heavy ~15MB). Brain.js v2.0.0-beta (neural networks, lightweight ~500KB but beta stability). ml.js v0.0.1 (experimental, minimal adoption). Recommendation: TensorFlow.js for production predictive models (conversation outcome, volume forecasting) with tf.sequential API. Features from conversation history: message_count, avg_latency, fallback_count, llm_calls, sentiment_scores. Model retraining: daily via BullMQ job with rolling 30-day window.
